results.title: [Solved] Who won the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024?
results.content:
India lifted the second T20 World Cup at Barbados' Kensington Oval on 29 June while playing the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024 final against South Africa. India posted a target of 177 runs and won by 7 runs.
 Chasing 177 runs at the Barbados' Kensington Oval, South Africa could only score 169/8 in 20 overs against India and lost by 7 runs in the the T20 World Cup 2024 final.
 Key Points
 Group A: India, United States, Pakistan, Canada, Ireland [...] The ICC Men's T20 World Cup, formerly known as the ICC World Twenty20, is a Twenty20 International cricket tournament organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC) since 2007.
 England are the current T20 World Cup champions, winning their second title by defeating Pakistan in the 2022 final.
 They are the first men's team to hold both limited-overs World Cups (T20 and ODI) simultaneously. [...] Testbook Logo

The ICC Men's T20 World Cup is a biennial world cup for cricket in Twenty20 International (T20I) format, organised by the International Cricket Council (ICC). It was first played in 2007 in South Africa, and the 2024 tournament marked its ninth edition. The eighth edition, held in 2022 in Australia, was contested by 16 teams, and was won by England who defeated Pakistan in the final.

results.title: 2024 Men's T20 World Cup final - Wikipedia
results.content:
India won the toss and electing to bat first, they registered a score of 176/7. In the second innings, South Africa managed to post a score of 169/8 thus India claimed the victory by 7 runs to win their second T20 World Cup title. Virat Kohli was named Player of the Match for scoring 76 runs off 59 balls. Following the victory, Kohli, Indian captain Rohit Sharma and Ravindra Jadeja announced their retirement from T20I cricket.
